```{r ggplot-settings}
#| warning: false
#| message: false
#| include: false

horzi_theme <- theme(    #   remove the gray background
  panel.background    = element_rect( size=.1, colour="black", fill="white") ,
  #   make the major gridlines light gray and thin
  panel.grid.major.y  = element_line( size=.1, colour="#666666" ) ,
  #   suppress the vertical grid lines
  panel.grid.major.x  = element_blank() ,
  #   suppress the minor grid lines
  panel.grid.minor    = element_blank() ,
  #   add axes
  axis.line           = element_line( size=.2 , colour="#666666" ),
  #   adjust the axis ticks
  axis.ticks          = element_line( size=.1 , colour="#666666" ),
  #   move the y-axis over to the left
  #axis.title.y        = element_text( angle=90, vjust=.5, hjust=.5 ),
  #   increase margin moved-over y-axis label fits
  # plot.margin = unit( c(.5,.25,.25,.5) , "in") ,
  title = element_text(  size=12 ) ,
  axis.title.x = element_text( size=12 ) ,
  axis.title.y = element_text( size=12 ) ,
  axis.text.x = element_text( size=12 ) ,
  axis.text.y = element_text( size=12 )
)

horzi <- horzi_theme

stat_sum_df <- function(fun, geom="crossbar", ...) {
  stat_summary(fun.data=fun, colour="black", geom=geom, width=.5,  ...)
}

# define the dodge object for equivalent error bar and geom_bar
dodge <- position_dodge(width=0.9)

# define a geom_bar
bars <- geom_bar(stat="summary", fun.y="mean", position="dodge")

theme_perez <- function() {
    ggplot2::theme_bw() +
    ggplot2::theme(
      axis.text = element_text(colour = "black",  family = "Times New Roman", size = 12),
    axis.title = element_text(colour = "black", family = "Times New Roman", size = 13),
    legend.title = element_text(colour = "black", family = "Times New Roman", size = 13),
    legend.text = element_text(colour = "black", family = "Times New Roman", size = 12),
    plot.title = element_text(colour = "black", family = "Times New Roman", size = 13),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(colour = "black", family = "Times New Roman", size = 13),
    strip.text = element_text(colour = "black", family = "Times New Roman", size = 13))
}
```

```{r data}
#| warning: false
#| message: false
#| include: false

data <- read.csv("Data-Clean_Wide_20250225.csv")
dataLong <- read.csv("Data-Clean_Long_20250225.csv")
```

# Overview
```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| code-fold: true

data <- data %>% 
  mutate(Condition = case_match(Condition,
                                "Control_Active" ~ "Control",
                                "Treatment_1" ~ "Trust & Perspectives",
                                "Treatment_2" ~ "Strategies & Outcomes"))

dataLong <- dataLong %>% 
  mutate(Condition = case_match(Condition,
                                "Control_Active" ~ "Control",
                                "Treatment_1" ~ "Trust & Perspectives",
                                "Treatment_2" ~ "Strategies & Outcomes"))

kable(table(data$Condition), col.names = c("Condition", "n"))
```

| Condition | Description |
|-----------|-------------|
| Active Control | Self-Explanatory |
| Treatment 1 | "Mindset" Articles |
| Treatment 2 | "Prescriptive" Articles |

# Relationship Attitudes

::: panel-tabset

#### α

```{r}
#| warning: false
#| message: false
#| code-fold: true
alpha_result <- psych::alpha(data[, c("manipCheck2", "manipCheck1")], check.keys=TRUE)
kable(alpha_result$total)
```

#### Models

::: panel-tabset
#### Item 1 
```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| code-fold: true
modManip1 <- lm(manipCheck1 ~ Condition + insurance_Patient + ladder + income + workInsurancePercent_1 + yearsWork_1, data)
tab_model(modManip1)
kable(emmeans::eff_size(emmeans(modManip1, ~Condition), sigma = sigma(modManip1), edf = df.residual(modManip1)))
emmManip1 <- emmeans(modManip1, "Condition")
pairsManip1 <- pairs(emmManip1)
kable(pairsManip1)
kable(data %>% 
        filter(!is.na(manipCheck1)) %>% 
        dplyr::group_by(as.factor(Condition)) %>% 
        dplyr::summarise(mean = mean(manipCheck1),
                         sd = sd(manipCheck1)))
```

#### Item 2
```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| code-fold: true
modManip2 <- lm(manipCheck2 ~ Condition + insurance_Patient + ladder + income + workInsurancePercent_1 + yearsWork_1, data)
tab_model(modManip2)
kable(emmeans::eff_size(emmeans(modManip2, ~Condition), sigma = sigma(modManip2), edf = df.residual(modManip2)))
emmManip2 <- emmeans(modManip2, "Condition")
pairsManip2 <- pairs(emmManip2)
kable(pairsManip2)
kable(data %>% 
        filter(!is.na(manipCheck2)) %>% 
        dplyr::group_by(as.factor(Condition)) %>% 
        dplyr::summarise(mean = mean(manipCheck2),
                         sd = sd(manipCheck2)))
```

```{r}
#| include: false
tab_model(modManip2, modManip1, show.se = T)
```

:::

#### Plots
```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| code-fold: true
item1 <- data %>% 
ggplot(aes(x=Condition, y=manipCheck1)) +
  geom_bar(stat="summary", position="dodge", fill = "grey40") +
  stat_sum_df("mean_cl_boot", geom = "errorbar", position= position_dodge(.9), conf.int=.68, width=0.2) +
  geom_jitter(alpha = 0.3) +
  expand_limits(y = c(1, 6)) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme_perez() +
  scale_x_discrete(limits = c("Control", "Trust & Perspectives", "Strategies & Outcomes"),
                   labels = c("Control", "Trust & \nPerspectives", "Strategies & \nOutcomes")) +
  labs(y = "It is NOT possible to prioritize a \nhigh-quality relationship with every patient.")

item2 <- data %>% 
ggplot(aes(x=Condition, y=manipCheck2)) +
  geom_bar(stat="summary", position="dodge", fill = "grey40") +
  stat_sum_df("mean_cl_boot", geom = "errorbar", position= position_dodge(.9), conf.int=.68, width=0.2) +
  geom_jitter(alpha = 0.3) +
  expand_limits(y = c(1, 6)) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme_perez() +
  scale_x_discrete(limits = c("Control", "Trust & Perspectives", "Strategies & Outcomes"),
                   labels = c("Control", "Trust & \nPerspectives", "Strategies & \nOutcomes")) +
  labs(y = "Patients will take advantage of you if \nyou ask for their input too often.")

plot <- ggarrange(item1, item2)

annotate_figure(plot, top = text_grob("Relationship Attitudes", face = "bold", size = 14))
```

# Lay Theories 

::: panel-tabset
#### α
```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| code-fold: true
alpha_result <- psych::alpha(data[, c("layTheories_1", "layTheories_2", "layTheories_3")])

kable(print(alpha_result$total), row.names = F)

keys.list <- list(c("layTheories_1", "layTheories_2", "layTheories_3"))

data$layTheores_combined <- scoreItems(keys = c(1, 1, 1),
                               items = data[, c("layTheories_1", "layTheories_2", "layTheories_3")],
                               min = 1, 
                               max = 6)$scores
```

#### Model 
```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| code-fold: true
modTheories <- lm(layTheores_combined ~ Condition + yearsWork_1, data = data)
tab_model(modTheories, show.se = T)
kable(emmeans::eff_size(emmeans(modTheories, ~Condition), sigma = sigma(modTheories), edf = df.residual(modTheories)))
emmTheor2 <- emmeans(modTheories, "Condition")
pairsTheor2 <- pairs(emmTheor2)
kable(pairsTheor2)
kable(data %>% 
        dplyr::group_by(as.factor(Condition)) %>% 
        dplyr::summarise(mean = mean(layTheores_combined),
                         sd = sd(layTheores_combined)))
```

#### Plot
```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| code-fold: true

data %>% 
ggplot(aes(x=Condition, y=layTheores_combined)) +
  geom_bar(stat="summary", position="dodge", fill = "grey40") +
  stat_sum_df("mean_cl_boot", geom = "errorbar", position= position_dodge(.9), conf.int=.68) +
  geom_jitter(alpha = 0.3) +
  expand_limits(y = c(1, 6)) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme_perez() +
  scale_x_discrete(limits = c("Control", "Trust & Perspectives", "Strategies & Outcomes"),
                   labels = c("Control", "Trust & \nPerspectives", "Strategies & \nOutcomes")) +
  labs(y = "Lay Theories of Patients")
```

# Vignette

## Main Outcomes

::: {.panel-tabset}

#### Patient Laziness

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| code-fold: true
modLazy <- lmer(lazy ~ Condition * strike + ladder + income + workInsurancePercent_1 + yearsWork_1 + insurance_Patient + trainingWhere + (1|ResponseId), data=dataLong, na.action=na.omit)
# summary(modLazy)

modLazy <- lmer(lazy ~ Condition + strike + ladder + income + workInsurancePercent_1 + yearsWork_1 + insurance_Patient + trainingWhere + (1|ResponseId), data=dataLong, na.action=na.omit)
tab_model(modLazy, title = "Main Effect Model Output")
kable(emmeans::eff_size(emmeans(modLazy, ~Condition), sigma = sigma(modLazy), edf = df.residual(modLazy)))
kable(emmeans::eff_size(emmeans(modLazy, ~strike), sigma = sigma(modLazy), edf = df.residual(modLazy)))

kable(psych::describe(dataLong$lazy), row.names = F)

ggplot(data=dataLong, aes(as.factor(strike), lazy, fill=Condition)) +
  geom_bar(stat="summary", fun.y="mean", position="dodge") +
  stat_sum_df("mean_cl_boot", geom = "errorbar", position= position_dodge(.9), conf.int=.68, width=0.2) +
  expand_limits(y=c(1:5)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks=c(1:5)) +
  scale_fill_grey() +
  theme_minimal() +
  xlab("Noncompliance Incident / 'Strike'") +
  ylab("Patient Laziness") +
  guides(fill=guide_legend(title="Intervention Condition")) +
  theme(legend.position="bottom") 
```

#### Attributions for Patient Noncompliance
```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| code-fold: true
modAttrib <- lmer(attributions ~ Condition * strike + ladder + income + workInsurancePercent_1 + yearsWork_1 + insurance_Patient + trainingWhere + (1|ResponseId), data=dataLong, na.action=na.omit)
# summary(modAttrib)

modAttrib <- lmer(attributions ~ Condition + strike + ladder + income + workInsurancePercent_1 + yearsWork_1 + insurance_Patient + trainingWhere + (1|ResponseId), data=dataLong, na.action=na.omit)
tab_model(modAttrib, title = "Main Effect Model Output")

ggplot(data=dataLong, aes(as.factor(Condition), attributions)) +
  geom_bar(stat="summary", fun.y="mean", position="dodge") +
  stat_sum_df("mean_cl_boot", geom = "errorbar", position= position_dodge(.9), conf.int=.68, width=0.2) +
  expand_limits(y=c(1:5)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks=c(1:5)) +
  scale_fill_grey() +
  theme_minimal() +
  xlab("Intervention Condition") +
  ylab("Attributons for Patient Behavior") +
  theme(legend.position="bottom") 
```
